name: discovery
description: Operate deterministic, evidence-backed discovery and research planning with the local Discovery CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Resolve intent and build durable research plans.
interface.longDescription: Guide Discovery's local CLI to capture request assertions, resolve questions, plan research lanes, record search provenance, review exact plan snapshots, and resume audited state. This release supports Phases 1 and 2, including claim admissibility, lane closure, and entry into Phase 3; later-phase completion is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Resume this Discovery run and explain its blocking questions and next actions.
Use Discovery to clarify this request and build an evidence-backed research plan.
